company.shortDescription: Fandom is a developer of an entertainment media platform designed for fans to explore, contribute to, and celebrate.
company.description: Fandom is a developer of a global entertainment media platform designed to provide a home for fans to explore, contribute to, and celebrate the world of pop culture. The company's platform offers users fandom entertainment related to games, movies, television, anime, and fandom wikis, providing fans with a single source for pop culture news, discussions, and discovery. It is also the home of D&D Beyond, a direct-to-consumer service/product supporting the passionate community and players of Dungeons & Dragons.

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Series E round raised $106,443,180, or 73.19% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $5,770,157 to $762,729,421, a 132.19x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.

insights.title: Sharp recent attention and growth momentum
insights.statement: Crunchbase scores growth at 29 (-24 over 90 days) and market heat at 41 (-14).
insights.implication: The company has recently become much more visible, but the scores should be treated as attention/activity indicators rather than revenue or clinical-performance metrics.
caveats: Crunchbase does not expose the complete weighting behind these proprietary scores.
